user.title: Add a voice persona router
user.description: The router sits in front of a conversation agent and changes its persona depending on who is speaking. After adding it, open its settings to fill in the personas.

data_description.name: Shown as the name of the new conversation agent, for example Kitchen assistant (by speaker).
data_description.agent: The agent that answers the people who live here.

init.title: Voice persona settings
init.description: Who is speaking comes from the voice_speaker helper of each satellite (owner, partner or stranger). Requests from the phone app or browser can be matched to the logged-in Home Assistant user instead. Changes apply to the next request, no restart needed.

data_description.agent: Answers Person 1 and Person 2, with its normal tools.

local.name: Built-in commands
local.description: Home Assistant's own quick commands, such as turn off the kitchen lights. They are only tried for Person 1 and Person 2, never for an unknown voice. For this to be the only way in, switch off Prefer handling commands locally on the voice assistants that use this router.

data.leave_questions: Leave questions and music searches to the main agent

data_description.enabled: A request that matches a built-in command exactly is carried out at once, without the main agent. Anything else goes to the main agent.
data_description.leave_questions: State questions such as is the door closed, and play music requests, go to the main agent even when a built-in command matches.

owner.name: Person 1
owner.description: Used when the voice_speaker helper says owner, or when this person's Home Assistant user sends a request from a device without a helper.

data_description.name: Put in front of this person's messages in the shared history, for example Alex.
data_description.user: Requests from the phone app, the browser or any device without a voice_speaker helper, made while logged in as this user, count as this person. Once any user is chosen, other logged-in users count as an unknown voice.
data_description.persona: Instructions added to the main agent's prompt when this person speaks.

partner.name: Person 2
partner.description: Used when the voice_speaker helper says partner, or when this person's Home Assistant user sends a request from a device without a helper.

data_description.name: Put in front of this person's messages in the shared history, for example Sam.
data_description.user: Requests from the phone app, the browser or any device without a voice_speaker helper, made while logged in as this user, count as this person. Once any user is chosen, other logged-in users count as an unknown voice.
data_description.persona: Instructions added to the main agent's prompt when this person speaks.

strangers.name: Unknown voices
strangers.description: An unknown voice never reaches the main agent or any tool, and the exchange is kept out of the shared history.

data_description.reply_agent: Must be an agent with no tool providers. It may not be the main agent.
data_description.persona: What the refusal agent is told about the person speaking.
data_description.fixed_replies: One line per row. One is picked at random when fixed lines are chosen, or when the refusal agent fails or is slow.

near_miss.name: Almost recognised
near_miss.description: For an unknown voice whose match score came close. The answer is still a refusal without tools, but it asks them to try again.

data.enabled: Ask to try again on a near miss
data.min_score: Lowest score that counts as a near miss
data.persona: Instructions for the try again reply

data_description.min_score: Compared with the Last speaker score sensor of the satellite. Scores from this value up to the satellite's own recognition level get the try again reply.
data_description.fixed_replies: One line per row. Used when fixed lines are chosen above, or when the refusal agent fails or is slow.

data.no_helper_role: A device without speaker recognition is

data_description.rule: Added to the main agent's prompt after the persona. Explains the name labels in the shared history.
data_description.wait_seconds: How long to wait while the helper says pending. If no match arrives in time, the voice counts as unknown.
data_description.no_helper_role: Used for a device that has no voice_speaker helper when no Home Assistant user decides it: nobody is logged in, or no user is chosen under Person 1 or Person 2.

error.same_user: Person 1 and Person 2 cannot have the same Home Assistant user.
